# Ezekiel 47 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-brought-me-back to the-entrance-of the-house, and-behold — water going-out from-under the-threshold-of the-house eastward, for the-face-of the-house [was] east; and-the-water was-coming-down from-under, from-the-right-side-of the-house, from-south-of the-altar.

**2** And-he-brought-me-out by-way-of the-gate northward and-led-me-around by-the-outside way to the-outer gate, the-way facing east; and-behold, water trickling from the-right-side.

**3** When-the-man went-out eastward with-a-line in-his-hand, he-measured a-thousand cubits and-caused-me-to-pass through the-water — water [reaching]-the-ankles.

**4** And-he-measured a-thousand and-caused-me-to-pass through the-water — water [reaching]-the-knees. And-he-measured a-thousand and-caused-me-to-pass-through — water [reaching]-the-loins.

**5** And-he-measured a-thousand — a-torrent which I-could-not pass-through, for the-water had-risen — water-of swimming — a-torrent which could-not be-crossed.

**6** And-he-said to-me, "Have-you-seen, son-of-man?" And-he-led-me and-brought-me-back to the-bank-of the-torrent.

**7** When-I-returned, behold — on the-bank-of the-torrent [were] trees, very many, on-this-side and-on-that-side.

**8** And-he-said to-me, "These waters go-out to the-eastern region and-go-down to the-Arabah and-enter the-sea — to the-sea the-stagnant-waters — and-the-waters will-be-healed.

**9** And-it-will-be [that] every living creature which swarms, everywhere the-river goes, will-live; and-there-will-be fish — very many — for these waters go there and-[the-waters]-are-healed; and-everything will-live where the-river goes.

**10** And-it-will-be [that] fishermen will-stand beside-it; from-En-Gedi to-En-Eglaim [will-be] a-place-for-spreading-of nets. According-to-their-kinds their-fish will-be, like the-fish-of the-Great Sea — very many.

**11** Its-swamps and-its-marshes will-not be-healed; to-salt they-are-given.

**12** And-by the-torrent, on-its-bank, on-this-side and-on-that-side, will-grow every tree-of food; its-leaf will-not-wither and-its-fruit will-not-fail. In-its-months it-will-bear-new-fruit, for its-waters — from the-sanctuary they-go-out; and-its-fruit will-be for-food and-its-leaf for-healing.

**13** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: "This [is] the-boundary by-which you-will-divide the-land as-an-inheritance for-the-twelve tribes-of Israel; Joseph [shall-have-two]-portions.

**14** And-you-will-inherit-it, each like-his-brother, which I-lifted My-hand to-give to-your-fathers; and-this land will-fall to-you as-an-inheritance.

**15** And-this [is] the-boundary-of the-land: on-the-north-side, from the-Great Sea, the-way-of Hethlon, to-the-entrance-of Zedad,

**16** Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim — which [is] between the-border-of Damascus and-the-border-of Hamath — Hazer-hatticon, which [is] on the-border-of Hauran.

**17** And-the-boundary from the-sea will-be Hazar-enan, the-border-of Damascus; and-the-north on-the-north-[side] [is] the-border-of Hamath. And-this [is] the-north-side.

**18** And-the-east-side: from-between Hauran and-Damascus and-Gilead and-the-land-of Israel — the-Jordan; from-[the]-border to the-eastern sea you-will-measure. And-this [is] the-east-side.

**19** And-the-south-side — southward: from-Tamar to the-waters-of Meribath-kadesh, [along]-the-brook to the-Great Sea. And-this [is] the-south-side — southward.

**20** And-the-west-side: the-Great Sea, from-[the]-border to-opposite the-entrance-of Hamath. This [is] the-west-side.

**21** And-you-will-divide this land for-yourselves according-to the-tribes-of Israel.

**22** And-it-will-be [that] you-will-divide-it-by-lot as-an-inheritance for-yourselves and-for the-sojourners who-sojourn in-your-midst, who have-fathered sons in-your-midst; and-they-will-be to-you as-native-born among the-sons-of Israel; with-you they-will-receive-an-inheritance among the-tribes-of Israel.

**23** And-it-will-be [that] in-whatever tribe the-sojourner sojourns, there you-will-give his-inheritance," declares the-Lord YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **47:1**: Mayim yotzim mi-tachat miftan ha-bayit — 'water going out from under the threshold of the house.' The trickle begins at the sacred threshold, connecting the life-giving water directly to God's presence in the temple.

- **47:9**: Kol-nefesh chayah asher-yishrotz — 'every living soul which swarms.' The vocabulary echoes Genesis 1:20-21, the original creation of aquatic life. The temple river reverses the curse and initiates new creation.

- **47:12**: The tree imagery — unfailing leaves and perpetual fruit — parallels the Tree of Life in Genesis 2-3 and directly prefigures Revelation 22:1-2. The sanctuary as source of healing reverses Eden's expulsion.

— EMET
